preconditions.description: The number of strings k is at least 1 and at most 2500.
The length of each string n is at least 2 and at most 5000.
The total length of the strings does not exceed 5000.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or (output.length == n and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in output))
postconditions.description: The output is either -1 or a string of length n consisting of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: output != -1 ==> exists s such that for all i in 1..k: swap_two_chars(s, s_i) == s_i
postconditions.description: If the output is not -1, then there exists a string s such that for each of the given strings s_i, swapping exactly two characters of s yields s_i.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 ==> not exists s such that for all i in 1..k: swap_two_chars(s, s_i) == s_i
postconditions.description: If the output is -1, then for all strings s, there exists at least one string s_i such that swapping exactly two characters of s does not yield s_i.
